description: What happened during this run? Returns one run's call metadata, approvals and approver names, recovery outcomes and delegated children; use it to reconstruct that session instead of gate_read_audit's project-wide calls or gate_get_run_tree's permission state. No bodies or query values. One run only; the project-wide log is gate_read_audit.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

before.description: Older audit events (timeline pages have at most 500 events)

project_id.description: The project id from project creation on the setup endpoint (/mcp/setup), e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_get_run_timeline
title: Read run timeline
